description: This file defines a React functional component 'CostTrackingSettings' that manages cost discount configurations for different providers. It includes UI elements for viewing, adding, editing, and removing provider discounts, as well as fetching and updating configuration data from a backend API.

methods.name: fetchDiscountConfig
methods.description: Fetches the current cost discount configuration from the backend API and updates local state.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Saves the current discount configuration to the backend API.

methods.name: handleAddProvider
methods.description: Adds a new provider discount entry to the configuration after validation.

methods.name: handleRemoveProvider
methods.description: Removes a provider from the discount configuration.

methods.name: handleDiscountChange
methods.description: Updates the discount value for a specific provider in the configuration state.
